title: When the Detention Burns
author: Ulyana Montrose
blurb: Rafael Underhill, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
